sourceAuthority: Advance Analytik sensor pages and their linked datasheets, reviewed 2026-09-23. Supersedes the user’s draft Vepolink PDF.

sensors.name: Digital pH Probe
sensors.lead: Track pH continuously through an RS-485 connection, with a glass electrode and built-in temperature compensation.
features: RS-485 with Modbus RTU supports two-way communication.
Integrated PT1000 temperature sensing supports compensation.
Protected power and communication circuits support field installation.
sensors.install: Use the 9–36 VDC supply and confirm the Modbus address, register map and wiring with the receiver. The temperature channel range is not the operating-temperature limit.
sensors.care: Keep the glass bulb and reference junction clean. Verify readings with suitable pH buffers and follow the electrode storage instructions.
sensors.pending: Confirm the operating-temperature limits; the source page and its datasheet give different lower limits.
specs: Shell: 316L stainless steel + POM; cable: polyurethane; glass electrode
10 m standard; extensions up to 200 m

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The glass electrode responds to the sample relative to a reference electrode. Temperature sensing and signal processing are integrated into the probe, which sends measurements over Modbus RTU.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the operating-temperature limits for the supplied model; the temperature channel range is a separate specification.

sensors.name: Analog pH Probe
sensors.lead: Measure how acidic or alkaline the water is using a combined glass electrode and Ag/AgCl reference.
features: Combined measuring and reference electrodes in a polypropylene body.
0–14 pH measurement for treatment and process water.
An optional conversion module provides an RS-485 connection.
sensors.install: Connect to an appropriate pH electrode input or transmitter. An analog electrode is not automatically a powered 4–20 mA transmitter; confirm the receiver and any conversion module.
sensors.care: Clean deposits from the glass bulb and reference junction, verify with pH buffers, and keep the electrode in the specified storage solution.

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: A glass indicating electrode and reference electrode share one body. A compatible measuring instrument reads their potential difference and converts it into a pH result.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Analog ORP Probe
sensors.method: Measuring electrode against a reference electrode
sensors.lead: Follow oxidation-reduction conditions with a combination electrode that measures solution potential against an Ag/AgCl reference.
features: Continuous redox potential measurement across a ±2000 mV range.
Polypropylene housing with an Ag/AgCl reference gel.
Optional conversion module for an RS-485 connection.
sensors.install: Use a receiver designed for an ORP electrode. Confirm the terminal connection and any transmitter needed for the plant input.
sensors.care: Keep the electrode and reference junction free of deposits. Verify response with a suitable redox standard; the listed quinhydrone values are reference checks, not measurement accuracy.
specs: ≥170 mV at 25 °C in saturated quinhydrone solution
≤ 10 sec (Reach 95% of the end value) (After stirring)
Standard: 10m, the maximum can be extended to 20m

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The measuring electrode and reference establish an electrical potential in the sample. The result describes oxidation-reduction conditions in millivolts and is distinct from a conductivity measurement.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Digital Conductivity Probe
sensors.lead: Measure conductivity across a wide range with a four-electrode graphite cell, automatic range switching and RS-485 communication.
features: Four-electrode sensing with graphite electrodes.
PT1000 temperature sensing supports compensation.
Modbus communication and a 3/4-inch mounting thread.
sensors.install: Provide 9–36 VDC and confirm Modbus settings. Choose the mounting and cable length for the site; temperature measurement capability does not extend the electrode operating limit.
sensors.care: Inspect the cell for coating and deposits. Clean using the model instructions and verify with conductivity standards appropriate to the working range.
sensors.pending: Housing information follows the specification table and datasheet. Confirm material and temperature-compensation limits for the supplied model.
specs: 10 m standard; extensions up to 200 m

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: Four electrodes measure electrical conductance through the water. The graphite sensing cell, automatic range switching and temperature compensation support measurements across changing conductivity conditions.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the housing material, mounting and temperature-compensation limits for the supplied configuration.

sensors.name: Analog Conductivity Probe
sensors.lead: Monitor conductivity with a glass-platinum electrode and temperature compensation, connected to a suitable conductivity instrument.
features: Polypropylene body with a glass-platinum electrode.
PT1000A temperature compensation.
10 m standard cable with extensions up to 20 m.
sensors.install: Confirm the cell constant, measurement range and electrode input before selecting the receiver. Specify any transmitter required for a 4–20 mA plant input.
sensors.care: Keep the cell free of deposits and verify it using an appropriate conductivity standard. Check the temperature input as part of commissioning.
sensors.pending: Confirm the conductivity range and cell constant. The source page and linked datasheet specify different ranges.
specs: Black polypropylene shell, glass platinum electrode
Standard: 10m, the maximum can be extended to 20m
≤10 sec (Reach 95% of the end value) (After stirring)

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The glass-platinum cell uses electrical voltage and current to determine conductivity. The receiving instrument must use the appropriate cell constant and temperature input.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the analog conductivity range and cell constant before selecting the receiver.

sensors.name: Analog TDS Probe
sensors.lead: Track dissolved solids using a glass-platinum electrode and temperature compensation, configured for the water being measured.
features: 0–20,000 mg/L range specified at K = 1.
PT1000 temperature compensation.
Polypropylene housing and a 10 m standard cable.
sensors.install: Use a compatible TDS or conductivity receiver. Confirm the cell constant and the conversion used to report dissolved solids for the site water.
sensors.care: Clean electrode deposits and verify against an appropriate reference. The relationship between conductivity and dissolved solids depends on the dissolved ions.
specs: Black polypropylene shell, glass platinum electrode
≤10 sec (Reach 95% of the end value after stirring)

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The probe uses an electrical conductivity measurement to derive a dissolved-solids value. The conversion should be configured for the composition of the water rather than treated as a direct measurement of every dissolved substance.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Optical Dissolved Oxygen Probe
sensors.lead: Measure dissolved oxygen optically for continuous monitoring, without consuming oxygen at the sensing cap.
features: Reports concentration or percentage saturation.
Temperature compensation and built-in diagnostics.
Factory calibration with field calibration available.
sensors.install: Connect the 9–36 VDC supply and RS-485 receiver. Select stainless steel or titanium to suit the water. Keep the sensing cap in representative water, clear of trapped bubbles.
sensors.care: Keep the optical cap clean and inspect it for damage. Verify calibration and replace the cap according to the selected model instructions.
specs: ±3% of reading or ±0.3 mg/L, whichever is greater
316L stainless steel for fresh water; titanium alloy for marine use
10 m standard; extensions up to 100 m
sensors.principle: Blue LED light excites the luminescent sensing cap, which emits red light. Oxygen changes the luminescence response; the sensor uses that change to determine dissolved oxygen concentration.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Residual Chlorine Probe
sensors.lead: Monitor residual chlorine through a controlled sample flow, using a constant-voltage electrode and two-point calibration.
features: Standard 0–2 mg/L range with a 0–20 mg/L option.
Manual or automatic temperature compensation.
Flow-cell installation with 30–60 L/h sample flow.
sensors.install: Provide the required sample flow and confirm the chlorine species, pH conditions and receiving instrument. The linked datasheet specifies 12 VDC and RS-485 Modbus.
sensors.care: Maintain flow through the cell, keep the electrode clean and verify calibration against the appropriate reference method. Set the service interval from site conditions.
sensors.pending: Confirm the cable and complete flow-cell configuration. Source documents give different cable lengths; no annual-only calibration interval is assumed.
sensors.principle: The electrode operates at a controlled potential and the measurement uses the resulting current. A suitable flow cell maintains sample delivery to the sensing surface.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the chlorine species, flow cell, cable and receiving interface together.

sensors.name: Turbidity Probe
sensors.lead: Measure suspended-particle effects on water clarity with infrared optical sensing and an optional automatic cleaning brush.
features: Select a 0.01–100 or 0.01–4000 NTU range.
Optional cleaning brush for fouling-prone installations.
Digital output with diagnostics for continuous monitoring.
sensors.install: Select the range for the expected water clarity and keep the optical path clear of bubbles and obstructions. Confirm the probe power supply and RS-485 configuration.
sensors.care: Clean the optical surfaces and verify with suitable turbidity standards. Include the optional brush in the maintenance plan when specified.
specs: Body: SUS316L (fresh water), Titanium alloy (Ocean marine)
<±2% of reading or ±0.1 NTU, whichever is greater

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: Infrared light interacts with particles in the water. The sensor uses the optical response to report turbidity; the selected range and clean optical surfaces determine the usable measurement.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Low-range Turbidity Sensor
sensors.method: Optical measurement in a flow cell
sensors.lead: Monitor low-turbidity water in a dedicated flow-through assembly with controlled sample flow and a digital connection.
features: Dedicated flow-through measurement up to 100 NTU.
12 VDC supply and RS-485 Modbus communication.
IP65 indoor assembly with separate inlet and outlet connections.
sensors.install: Mount indoors and feed 300–700 mL/min through the cell. Use the 1/4 NPT inlet and 1/2 NPT outlet. This IP65 assembly is not an immersion probe.
sensors.care: Keep the flow cell clean and free of trapped bubbles. Verify the low-range response using suitable standards and maintain a steady sample flow.
sensors.pending: Confirm the lower measurement limit, resolution and accuracy for the selected version; the source page and datasheet differ at the low end.
specs: Up to 100 NTU; confirm the lower limit
Machine: ABS+SUS316L; Sealing Element: Acrylonitrile Butadiene Rubber; Cable: Polyurethane
Three-meter standard cable, The LED version can be extended up to 30 meters
sensors.principle: A dedicated flow cell presents a controlled water sample to the optical measurement. A steady sample supply and a clean cell are important when assessing low turbidity.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the lower measurement limit, resolution and accuracy for the selected version.

sensors.name: UV COD Probe
sensors.lead: Follow organic contamination continuously using UV-visible absorption, with optical compensation and automatic cleaning.
features: Direct immersion measurement without chemical reagents.
Optical compensation for colour and turbidity.
Automatic cleaning to reduce deposits on the measurement window.
sensors.install: Select the optical path and calibration for the water matrix. COD, BOD and TOC values are optical estimates that need a site-appropriate correlation, rather than separate wet-chemistry tests.
sensors.care: Inspect and clean the optical window and cleaning mechanism. Verify the correlation against the appropriate laboratory reference method when the water matrix changes.
sensors.pending: Confirm optical path, COD-equivalent range, housing material, pressure rating and output interface. The source page and datasheet describe different configurations.
sensors.principle: Organic substances absorb ultraviolet and visible light. The probe measures that absorption and applies compensation and calibration to report organic-load estimates, including COD-equivalent values.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm optical path, COD-equivalent range, housing material, pressure rating and output interface.

sensors.name: Suspended Solids Probe
sensors.lead: Monitor suspended-solids and sludge concentration with infrared optical sensing, configurable ranges and optional automatic cleaning.
features: Three concentration ranges up to 20,000, 45,000 or 120,000 mg/L.
Optional automatic cleaning for deposit-prone sites.
RS-485 Modbus communication and onboard diagnostics.
sensors.install: Select the range and cleaning configuration for the sludge. Install in representative, well-mixed water and confirm the required supply and receiver.
sensors.care: Keep the optical surfaces clean and check the measurement against representative samples. Accuracy depends on sludge homogeneity and the calibration used.
specs: Diameter: 60mm, Length: 251.5mm - (without cleaning) Diameter: 60mm, Length: 261.5mm - (with cleaning)
Body: SUS316L (fresh water), Titanium alloy (Ocean marine)
<±5% of measured value; depends on sludge homogeneity
Standard: 10m, the maximum may be extended to 100m
sensors.principle: A dual-beam infrared system measures light scattered by suspended particles. The concentration result depends on the selected range, calibration and how uniformly the solids are distributed in the sample.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Chlorophyll-a Probe
sensors.lead: Track chlorophyll-a fluorescence directly in the water for continuous observation of algal activity.
features: Direct optical measurement without sample extraction.
Digital communication over RS-485 Modbus.
Use multiple monitoring points where distribution is uneven.
sensors.install: Use the specified low-voltage supply and confirm the receiving interface. The source recommends water turbidity below 50 NTU and multiple points where distribution varies.
sensors.care: Keep the optical window clean and verify the response using the recommended reference. Fluorescence needs interpretation alongside the site water conditions.
specs: ±5% of the signal corresponding to 1 ppb Rhodamine B dye
Standard: 10m, the maximum may be extended to 100m

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The optical system excites chlorophyll-a at a suitable wavelength and measures its fluorescence. The fluorescence response provides an indicator of chlorophyll-a content without extracting a laboratory sample.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the selected range, interface, cable and mounting against the current model datasheet before ordering.

sensors.name: Blue-green Algae Probe
sensors.lead: Follow a fluorescence-based indicator of blue-green algae, with readings reported in cells per millilitre.
features: 0–300,000 cells/mL reported range.
RS-485 Modbus communication.
Multipoint monitoring supports uneven algae distribution.
sensors.install: Confirm the enclosure rating and permissible immersion before installation. Use representative monitoring locations and observe the stated turbidity condition.
sensors.care: Keep the optical window clear and verify using the specified reference method. Fluorescence does not directly identify toxins or every cyanobacterial species.
sensors.pending: Confirm the enclosure rating before immersion: the web table lists IP65/NEMA 4X while the linked datasheet lists IP68/NEMA 6P.
specs: ±10% of the signal corresponding to 1 ppb Rhodamine B dye
Body: SUS316L + Polyvinyl Chloride, Cover: Polyoxymethylene, Cable: Polyurethane
Standard: 10m, the maximum may be extended to 100m
Turbidity below 50 NTU; consider multipoint monitoring for uneven algae distribution

imageSource.note: Supplier product-page assignment accepted per user clarification: similar products can share photographs; repetition alone is not treated as an error.

sensors.principle: The optical system measures pigment fluorescence as an indicator of blue-green algae. A calibration expresses that signal in cells per millilitre; the response can vary with the organisms and water conditions.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the enclosure rating and permissible immersion before installation.

sensors.name: Oil in Water Probe
sensors.lead: Detect oil-related fluorescence in water with a UV optical sensor and an optional self-cleaning brush.
features: UV fluorescence with optical and electronic filtering.
RS-485 Modbus connection.
Optional brush for fouling-prone installations.
sensors.install: Confirm the oil type, reporting units and concentration range for the application. Position the probe in representative water and select a suitable body material.
sensors.care: Inspect the optical window for oil films and deposits. Verify calibration for the target oil and the actual water matrix; plan brush maintenance if fitted.
sensors.pending: Confirm range, detection limit and resolution. The source page and datasheet disagree, and the listed resolution has no usable unit.
specs: Body: SUS316L, titanium alloy; Cable: Polyurethane
sensors.principle: Ultraviolet excitation produces fluorescence from responsive oil components. Optical and electronic filtering distinguish the measured response from background light, while calibration relates it to the target oil.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the target oil, reporting units, range, detection limit and resolution.

sensors.name: Ammonia Nitrogen Probe
sensors.lead: Monitor ammonia nitrogen continuously with pH and temperature compensation and a digital connection.
features: NH4-N monitoring with pH and temperature compensation.
RS-485 Modbus communication.
5 m standard cable, with custom lengths available.
sensors.install: Confirm the nitrogen range, water chemistry and calibration requirements. The source specifies up to 10 m immersion for this probe; verify the supplied configuration before installation.
sensors.care: Clean the sensing surfaces and verify with appropriate standards. Set calibration and sensor maintenance intervals for the site water and interfering ions.
sensors.pending: Confirm the sensing configuration, NH4-N range, accuracy and resolution; the source page and its datasheet publish different values.
sensors.principle: The probe reports ammonia nitrogen and compensates for pH and temperature. Select the sensing configuration and calibration for the expected concentration, water chemistry and interfering ions.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm the sensing configuration, NH4-N range, accuracy and resolution.

sensors.name: Nitrate Nitrogen Probe
sensors.lead: Follow nitrate nitrogen with automatic pH and temperature compensation and an RS-485 Modbus output.
features: 0–3000 mg/L reported as nitrate nitrogen.
Automatic pH and temperature compensation.
Low-voltage digital interface with a 5 m standard cable.
sensors.install: Use a 6–12 VDC supply and confirm the Modbus configuration. Select the probe together with the required calibration method and water chemistry.
sensors.care: Verify with standard solution and plan calibration for the site conditions. The stated accuracy is a laboratory result obtained within six hours of calibration.
sensors.pending: Confirm nitrate resolution and sensing configuration; the source page lists 0.1 ppm while its datasheet lists 0.01 ppm.
specs: ±10% or ±0.2 mg/L, obtained within 6 h of calibration with standard solution under laboratory conditions
sensors.principle: The probe reports nitrate nitrogen and applies pH and temperature compensation. Its laboratory accuracy qualification makes calibration conditions an important part of interpreting field performance.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm nitrate resolution, calibration conditions and the sensing configuration.

sensors.name: Dissolved Ozone Probe
sensors.lead: Measure dissolved ozone in a controlled sample flow using a two-electrode system and a selective permeable membrane.
features: 0–20 ppm measurement with integrated temperature compensation.
Approximately 15 s T90 response.
Flow-cell operation at 250–500 mL/min.
sensors.install: Provide the specified flow through the measuring cell and confirm the power, output and receiving instrument. Internal digital processing alone does not establish an external digital interface.
sensors.care: Inspect the membrane and follow the electrode maintenance instructions. Calibrate the slope against the appropriate analytical reference on the receiving instrument.
sensors.pending: Confirm external output, supply voltage and enclosure protection for the selected assembly; these are not specified in the source technical table.
specs: T90: about 15s (up to 90% of the measured value)
On the measuring device, determined by analytical methods
Standard:10m, the maximum may be extended to 100m
sensors.principle: A permeable membrane separates the sample from a two-electrode measuring system. The membrane design reduces chemical interference, while integrated temperature compensation supports the result.
sensors.confirmation: Confirm external output, supply voltage and enclosure protection for the selected assembly.
